scope.spacetime: Spherical Reissner–Nordström charged background plus fully evolving neutral minimally coupled massless scalar; 1+1D double-null equations
scope.metric: ds² = -exp(2sigma) du dv + r² dOmega²; g_uv=-exp(2sigma)/2
scope.initial_domain_u_and_v: 0 <= u,v <= 0.4, both finite; stable trapped patch inside ideal RN outer horizon and above inner horizon
scope.boundary_pulses: phi(u,0)=A sin²(pi u/L), phi(0,v)=B sin²(pi v/L), L=0.4, both vanish at shared corner

equations.initial_r_boundaries: dr/ds=F(r)/2, from same r0; inside trapped region F<0
equations.initial_sigma: sigma_RN(s)=(1/2)ln[-F(r(s))]; correction = integral r*phi_s²/F(r) ds enforcing null constraints along both initial characteristics
equations.boundary_constraint_derivation: r_ss-2 sigma_s r_s+r phi_s²=0; r_s=F/2, r_ss=F'F/4, sigma_s=F'/4+r phi_s²/F
equations.initial_data_compatibility: r,sigma,phi agree at u=v=0; null constraints imposed on both characteristic arms before evolution.

numerical_method.diamond_rule: Implicit centered double-null NE = SE+NW−SW+h² RHS(midpoint) with full four-corner derivative averages
numerical_method.boundary_sigma_correction: Simpson rule integrating constraint source r phi_s²/F(r)
numerical_method.interior_constraints: finite-difference Cuu,Cvv monitored on all (N−1)² interior cells; not imposed by projection
numerical_method.independent_resolution_test: Four refinements, halving h yields ~4 reduction in checkpoint solution differences
numerical_method.test_center_location: u=v=0.2 characteristic midpoint; not proper-time observer position
numerical_method.point_status: inside trapped finite patch with r_u<0 and r_v<0 in all four cases; not near r_-=0.4

tests.domain: RN trapped region r0=1.2, Q=.8; no inner-horizon limit

tested_results.scientific_interpretation: Nonlinear coupling is nonzero at the midpoint and initial-data controls are distinguished, but bounded small patch does not establish mass inflation or Cauchy instability.
tested_results.filename_data_table: 4x729 samples from four actual N=192 numerical grids, not 729 stellar observations or 729 proper-time ticks
tested_results.HTML_mock_interactions: PASS: vacuum vs both, 192 refinement, modified fluxes, 24! forward/last-seam/backward and invalid rank guard

theory_sources.role: Double-null free evolution, constraints monitored, second order accuracy and charged scalar perturbation model

cautions: Second-order grid convergence does not demonstrate late-time power-law tails or inner-horizon mass inflation; the simulated patch remains well above inner RN radius.
The result is spherical and electrically charged; Kerr is rotating and the two systems are not interchangeable.
No numerical solution in this work approaches the Cauchy horizon, assesses physical collapse, or maps the full Sgr A* observed spacetime.
An arbitrary neutral scalar pulse A,B and a charged background Q/M0=0.8 were assumed, not measured. Neither Q nor scalar amplitude is inferred for Sgr A*.
Double-null metric functions carry gauge freedom; some coordinate derivatives are gauge-dependent. Charged Hawking mass is spherical invariant when evaluated from geometry.
The monitor Cuu/Cvv is a finite difference residual in grid coordinates; the RMS values have grid-dependent normalization and cannot be treated as physics uncertainty bars.
Initial null constraint satisfaction is enforced numerically by constraint integration; interior constraints monitored only, avoiding hiding evolution failure.
The convergent positive change in spherical charged mass parameter at a checkpoint does not prove an explosive divergence approaching an inner horizon.
These are 729 chosen numerical u,v coordinate samples per control; original 729 Galactic stations and the 24! ring are not changed.
No Planck-scale limit, quantum gravity microstructure or physical central core inferred.
